input-field.name: llmBaseUrl
input-field.label: OpenAI-compatible base URL
input-field.helpText: Any OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint (Azure, OpenRouter, a local model). The URL is validated on every request to block egress into private networks; a private or loopback address is rejected.

input-field.name: llmModel
input-field.label: Model
input-field.helpText: The assistant is inert until this is set. A weak model reads as a bad product: prefer a model with reliable tool calling.

input-field.name: llmApiKey
input-field.label: API key
input-field.helpText: Prefer an environment variable. Shopware system config has no real secret storage, so a key entered here is readable by anyone with config access and is included in database backups.

input-field.name: agentVoice
input-field.label: Agent voice
input-field.helpText: Tone and persona only. This text cannot grant the assistant a capability: what it may do is decided by which tools are constructed, never by instruction.

input-field.name: excludedCategories
input-field.label: Excluded category IDs
input-field.helpText: One ID per line. Products in these categories are never retrieved.

input-field.name: blockedProducts
input-field.label: Blocked product IDs
input-field.helpText: One ID per line. Blocked products never enter the model's context and never appear in a reply — the block is a retrieval filter, not a prompt instruction.

input-field.name: blockedCategories
input-field.label: Blocked category IDs
input-field.helpText: One ID per line. Same guarantee as blocked products.

input-field.name: enableAddToCart
input-field.label: Allow the assistant to add items to the cart
input-field.helpText: When off, the add-to-cart tool is never constructed, so the model cannot see it and cannot call it.

input-field.name: maxItemQuantity
input-field.label: Maximum quantity per item
input-field.helpText: Checked against the live cart, not against a single call, so repeated small additions cannot accumulate past it.

input-field.name: maxCartValue
input-field.label: Maximum cart value
input-field.helpText: In the sales channel's currency. Also checked against the live cart total.

input-field.name: maxToolCallsPerTurn
input-field.label: Maximum tool calls per turn
input-field.helpText: Bounds cost and stops a model looping. Reaching the cap ends the turn gracefully with whatever was already grounded, never with an error.

input-field.name: dailyRequestCap
input-field.label: Daily request cap
input-field.helpText: The chat endpoint is public, so this is a security control rather than an operational nicety.

input-field.name: killSwitch
input-field.label: Kill switch — stop the assistant
input-field.helpText: Rejects every turn before any model spend. Takes precedence over the daily cap, so the trace records why it stopped.
